comment: There's a LOT of material to cover in this class, but Dr. Hayes made material clear and used Blackboard a lot. She is willing to help, but you have to go to office hrs and get to know her!  She is genuine and cares for the students. I don't like daily quizzes, but  I think I learned a lot about statistics and research with her.

Dr. Hayes is great. She knows her material and the research world. You can tell she is really passionate about her area of research. Answers questions and has good office hours. Tests are fair if you study. Lots of extra credit opportunity.

I know the material in class, participate a lot. BUT, her tests' style is often too ambitious. Although you know the topic, you might barely finish the exam and end up dropping ur grade. Lots of homework in week. She has a good intention. But I believe our learning process in this class could be done more effectively.

Not the best teacher, but clear grading criteria. Had to definitely work outside of class, but the material and her tests were not that hard. I read for the class, and did questions from the text occasionally and did fine in the class. Very willing to give feedback and gives quite a few extra credit options.

Quizzes every day, tons of work -- the workload of 2 courses. Exhausting and boring material.  She does not do the best job explaining the material and you are basically on your own to learn it.  However, you must go to the classes because of the daily quizzes.  Overall would not recommend taking her
